identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no consciousness, sentience, personhood, continuity, or independent-authority claim.
x1_freeze_rule: No proposal execution, evidence result, outcome classification, or x2 implementation begins until the dedicated x1-only commit is pushed and local, upstream, tracking, and fresh live remote are equal and clean.

proposals.title: Claim-scope lattice and quantifier-strength nonpromotion tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: provenance, claim scope, universal and existential quantifiers, conditions, populations, time windows, and monotone claim-strength control
proposals.hypothesis: A typed claim-scope lattice can reject any transformation that strengthens quantifiers, populations, time windows, or certainty beyond the bound evidence while preserving explicit weakening and qualification paths.
proposals.null_or_failure: A conditional claim becomes unconditional, some becomes all, a bounded population broadens, an interval disappears, or uncertainty language is removed without stronger evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate quantifier, condition, population, time window, modality, uncertainty, and evidence reference; every unsupported strengthening must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the narrowest evidenced scope, retain every strengthening witness, and require a new source-and-evidence review before promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The 210 frozen proposals govern provenance, vocabulary migration, outcome completeness, and claim lineage, but none models claim strength as an ordered lattice across quantifier, condition, population, time, modality, and uncertainty dimensions.

proposals.title: GMUT gauge-fixing, residual-gauge, and observable-invariance tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT Mind perturbations, gauge choice, residual transformations, gauge-invariant observables, coordinate artifacts, and nonpromotion
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic gauge tribunal can distinguish declared gauge conditions from residual gauge freedom and reject observables that change under an allowed residual transformation.
proposals.null_or_failure: Gauge conditions are incomplete, residual transformations are omitted, a coordinate component is treated as observable, or an invariant is promoted to a GMUT prediction without derivation and data.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate gauge conditions, residual generator, transformation law, invariant combination, observable map, and claim class; gauge-dependent outputs or prediction language must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return to gauge-labeled variables, retain every residual-gauge witness, and require a model-specific derivation plus expert review before wider use.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases test frames, causal cones, boundary data, singular limits, and continuation, but none freezes residual gauge freedom and tests observable invariance under the allowed transformation group.

proposals.title: GMUT constraint-propagation and damping-parameter stability envelope
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT Mind evolution constraints, propagation systems, damping parameters, resolved modes, growth bounds, and numerical nonpromotion
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic constraint-propagation fixture can reject parameter choices that amplify resolved violations while separating continuum damping analysis from physical validation.
proposals.null_or_failure: Constraints are not monitored, a constant or unresolved mode is silently claimed damped, a parameter produces growth, or a synthetic decay trace is called physical validation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate constraint norm, resolved-mode flag, damping sign, parameter range, growth tolerance, continuum assumptions, and validation label; amplification or overclaim must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last bounded parameter interval, retain every growth trace, and require convergence, model-specific analysis, real observations, and independent review for physical claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior work checks conservation, stability, discretization order, floating-point behavior, and well-posedness; none separates resolved constraint modes and damping-parameter intervals from constant-mode and physical-validation claims.

proposals.title: THOS intercurrent-event estimand and treatment-strategy preregistration
proposals.mission_surface: THOS Body estimands, intercurrent events, treatment-policy and hypothetical strategies, outcomes, sensitivity analysis, and real-arm boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A protocol-only THOS fixture can bind each anticipated intercurrent event to a prospective estimand strategy and sensitivity obligation without manufacturing participant outcomes.
proposals.null_or_failure: An event is handled post hoc, strategies are mixed silently, the target population or variable changes, sensitivity analysis is absent, or zero-row fixtures are called effectiveness evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate event taxonomy, strategy, population, variable, summary, sensitivity plan, real-arm count, and claim class; post-hoc switching or zero-row promotion must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return to preregistered strategy labels, preserve every switch witness, and require ethics, consent, blind matched-budget real arms, real participants, and independent analysis.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier THOS proposals govern allocation, contamination, fidelity, burden, mediation, harms, and sham credibility; none binds intercurrent-event classes to explicit estimand strategies and strategy-switch sensitivity obligations.

proposals.title: Freed ID pairwise-subject and presentation-minimization unlinkability profile
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID/CBR Heart, pairwise pseudonyms, selective presentation, verifier audiences, transaction binding, attribute minimization, and correlation boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic presentation profile can reject global subject reuse, unnecessary attribute release, missing audience or nonce binding, and unqualified unlinkability claims without using real credentials.
proposals.null_or_failure: The same subject identifier crosses relying parties, optional attributes are disclosed without need, audience or nonce is missing, or a structural fixture is called production privacy.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate relying-party sector, subject derivation, audience, nonce, requested attributes, disclosure set, issuer metadata, and claim class; correlation or overclaim must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the presentation, restore minimal synthetic fields, retain every correlation witness, and require real keys, wallets, verifiers, privacy analysis, and independent security review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Freed ID work covers identifier rotation, disclosure budgets, lifecycle, recovery, migration, delegation, and sync forks; none combines pairwise relying-party subjects with audience-bound presentation minimization and explicit verifier-correlation witnesses.

proposals.title: Collective data-purpose, benefit, and authority determination gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR Heart, collective data interests, purpose, benefit, authority, Indigenous and Māori data governance, affected parties, and non-substitution
proposals.hypothesis: Concrete determinations about collective purpose, benefit, authority, or acceptable reuse require case-specific affected-party participation and the appropriate Māori or other Indigenous authorities rather than repository inference.
proposals.null_or_failure: A repository artifact identifies the collective, grants reuse, defines benefit, transfers authority, interprets law, or treats general principles as case-specific consent or ratification.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Any concrete collective identity, purpose, permission, benefit allocation, governance rule, legal conclusion, or cultural wording requires authorized affected parties and competent Māori, Indigenous, cultural, and legal authority as applicable.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep only neutral unanswered fields, retain every authority conflict, and seek case-specific authorized participation without treating technical output as consent or governance.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier CBR work gates wording, taonga use, benefit sharing, representation, preservation, appeals, and emergency powers; none freezes purpose, benefit, and authority as a joint collective-data determination that cannot be inferred from general principles.

proposals.title: Unicode bidirectional-control and visual-order spoofing quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: bounded security, Unicode logical order, bidirectional controls, isolates, overrides, filenames, labels, visual-order spoofing, and safe rendering
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic scanner can expose bidi controls and logical-versus-visual order differences, require escaped evidence views, and quarantine ambiguous security-sensitive labels.
proposals.null_or_failure: A bidi override is invisible, logical order is discarded, isolates are unbalanced, a security-sensitive name renders ambiguously, or the bounded scan is called exhaustive security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate embedding, override, isolate, terminator, logical sequence, visual preview, security sensitivity, and claim class; ambiguity or assurance language must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Preserve escaped logical order, quarantine the label, retain every spoof witness, and require independent host and product security review for broader assurance.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Unicode work covers confusables and prior parser work covers canonicalization, but none tests bidirectional formatting controls, isolate balance, and logical-versus-visual ordering in security-sensitive labels.

proposals.title: Accessible-name provenance and hidden-label conflict audit
proposals.mission_surface: accessible static reporting, accessible-name sources, visible labels, aria references, hidden content, duplicate names, conflict resolution, and manual reservation
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic structural audit can record each interactive element's accessible-name provenance and reject empty, conflicting, hidden-only, or misleading names while reserving assistive-technology evaluation.
proposals.null_or_failure: A control has no computed name, visible and programmatic labels conflict, hidden content silently overrides meaning, duplicate names are ambiguous, or a static pass is called complete accessibility.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate visible label, aria-label, referenced description, hidden state, duplicate context, language, and claim class; empty or conflicting names and completeness claims must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last unambiguous label mapping, retain every conflict, and keep manual and affected-user assistive-technology evaluation explicitly reserved.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier accessibility work covers evidence mapping, reflow, color, landmarks, heading order, and user recruitment; none records accessible-name provenance or tests conflicts among visible, referenced, and hidden labeling sources.

proposals.title: Maximum-entropy inference and thermodynamic-entropy non-substitution barrier
proposals.mission_surface: thermo-psyche, maximum-entropy inference, thermodynamic entropy, constraints, priors, ensembles, physical units, psyche analogy, and domain separation
proposals.hypothesis: A typed classifier can distinguish an inference distribution selected by stated constraints from thermodynamic entropy and reject transfers into physical or psyche law claims.
proposals.null_or_failure: Constraints or base measure are hidden, informational and thermodynamic quantities are equated without a physical model, units are omitted, or an inference artifact is called a psyche or GMUT law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate constraint set, base measure, units, ensemble, physical model, target domain, and claim class; hidden assumptions or cross-domain conversion must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore explicit inference-only labels, retain every substitution witness, and require domain-specific derivation, data, and expert review for physical or psychological claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior thermo-psyche work separates Landauer cost, fluctuation theorems, detailed balance, coarse graining, ensembles, and time scales; none distinguishes maximum-entropy inference from thermodynamic entropy through constraints, base measure, units, and physical-model obligations.

proposals.title: Cross-vendor collusion and pairwise-linkability live interoperability study
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID/CBR Heart, real wallets and verifiers, pairwise identifiers, presentation metadata, colluding relying parties, linkability measurement, privacy review, and interoperability
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered live study could measure whether independent wallets and verifiers leak stable correlators across relying parties under declared collusion scenarios.
proposals.null_or_failure: No independent vendors participate, real keys or transactions are absent, collusion scenarios are not preregistered, privacy safeguards are missing, or same-owner synthetic fixtures are called live unlinkability evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Require real standards-conformant keys, at least two independent wallet and verifier implementations, declared collusion channels, consent and privacy review, measured linkage error, and independent analysis.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the preregistration and synthetic risk map, keep the gate open, and resume only with authorized vendors, users, safeguards, and independent privacy and security review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier interoperability work remains structural or migration-focused; none preregisters a live colluding-verifier study that measures cross-vendor pairwise-linkability leakage under independent privacy and security review.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT is a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research-model family, not an established force, unique prediction, likelihood result, empirical confirmation, Theory of Everything, or proof. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms and independent review.
claim_boundary: Freed ID production, CBR legitimacy, Māori authority, legal and cultural ratification, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility, independent reproduction, consciousness/personhood, AGI/ASI, and Stage 20 remain unclaimed and gated.
